text:
maya: Quick sync: proposing a staggered EU rollout for model_v2 with tenant opt-in windows and automatic fallback. Need alignment on cohorts, telemetry gates, and runbook ops.

devin: Sounds good. I propose cohorts: internal-only -> enterprise opt-ins -> 3% sample -> 15% -> 50% -> full. Each step 24648h with explicit gating. Keep per-tenant opt-out and tenant-scoped flags.

sam: Ops constraints: add a queue-depth and GPU util breaker; also require a graceful degrade path for latency SLOs. What exact numbers?

devin: Suggested thresholds: p95 <= 400ms for latency-sensitive endpoints, 5xx+timeout rate < 0.8% over a 10m window, queue length < 150, GPU mem < 80% for sustained 5m. If breaker triggers, shift 100% of traffic in-region to model_v1_kvcached.

liz: QA will run a smoke eval suite and a structured-output regression test before each percentage jump. If any structured mismatch > 0.5% on critical prompts, block the move.

bryan: Sales asked for two EU customers to be in a private opt-in cohort with a 2h escalation and rollback contact. Confirm they won't be swept into random samples unless they opt in.

maya: Plan: assign cohorts in order: internal -> private opt-ins -> shards of random sample. Private opt-ins get a named support point and a single-click portal rollback.

rollout-bot: Draft feature flag created for review:```
flag: eu_model_v2_rollout
rollout: phased
cohorts: [internal, private_optins, random_3pct, 15pct, 50pct, 100pct]
metrics_primary: [p95_latency_ms, error_rate_5xx, timeout_rate]
metrics_secondary: [eval_regression_rate, semantic_drift_score]
fallback: eu_model_v1
degrade: eu_model_v1_kvcached
kill_triggers:
  - p95_latency_ms > 400 for 10m
  - error_rate_5xx+timeout_rate >= 0.8% for 10m
  - gpu_mem_util >= 80% for 5m
  - queue_length >= 150 for 10m
```

maya: @liz can QA hook the smoke runner to publish a pass/fail boolean and a short JSON report in this thread before any cohort increase? If it fails, it should also post a short failure reason and attach the eval job id.

liz: Yes. Ill add a gate in the rollout pipeline that waits for smoke_runner:status == PASS for opt-in and random_3pct steps. If FAIL => post report and set flag to hold.

sam: Oncall playbook excerpt:
- If any kill trigger fires: `/rollout abort --flag eu_model_v2_rollout --reason safety_trigger`
- Immediate fallback: shift to `eu_model_v1` and notify #eng-oncall, #product, and the private opt-ins list.
- If degrade needed only: route latency-sensitive traffic to `eu_model_v1_kvcached` while keeping non-critical traffic on v2 for diagnostics.

devin: Telemetry gating: require 1h of stable metrics after each jump for 3% and 15% steps, 4h for 50% step. Telemetry dashboards will auto-evaluate and post a green/red summary.

bryan: For the two enterprise opt-ins: confirm they are excluded from the random sample and that the portal shows their current cohort and rollback link. I will confirm legal contacts and provide support names.

maya: Launch checklist before 15% increase:
- Internal 24h pass with no primary breaches
- Opt-in cohort smoke eval pass and structured-output check
- Telemetry green for required window
- Support contacts assigned and portal rollback tested
- Rollout flag config reviewed and audit-logging enabled

devin: Timeline proposal: dry-run = Tue internal, internal canary Wed (24h), private opt-ins Thurs-Fri, random_3pct Sat (24h), 15% Sun (48h), 50% Mon (48h) if all pass. Abort allowed at any stage.

liz: Ill post the smoke eval job ids and attach the first run summary when dry-run completes.

sam: Ops to implement circuit-breakers and the degrade route by EOD Monday. Confirmed we'll add automated rollback commands to the runbook and a single-button rollback in the portal.

maya: OK locking the plan unless objections. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve.

devin: :thumbsup:

liz: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

bryan: :thumbsup:
